thread:
Lina (CS): FYI — we have a subset of enterprise trial accounts hitting an activation/ingest stall after the recent index migration. Early warning: some of these are in renewal review. If we don't show progress in 72h we may surface renewal risk to CRO. 

Lina (CS): Draft outreach I'm planning to send if we can't commit to a <24h fix (please review):

"Dear <Account Team>,

We wanted to proactively notify you of an intermittent activation and indexing delay that may affect ingest and search freshness. Our engineering team is investigating and we expect to have a mitigation plan within 24–48 hours. We understand the impact this may have on your deployment timelines and are offering a prioritized support channel + a scheduled troubleshooting session with our team.

Next steps we will take:
- Provide hourly status updates until resolved
- Offer a dedicated office hours slot within 48 hours
- Apply a one-time credit if SLA targets are missed

Thank you for your patience — Lina, Customer Success
"

Mike (Eng): Repro steps and root hint: looks like a small race in the reindex job where long-running ingest tasks are being preempted by a cleanup TTL job. Patch ready, scheduling a hotfix deploy at 02:30 PT. ETA ~2h for rollout and validation. Will post logs here. :wrench:

Raj (Sales): Thanks — please flag the top 5 accounts by ARR and renewal date so I can pause automated renewal nudges and prep exec outreach. I can join office hours if needed.

Aisha (Support): I'm setting up a dedicated support queue and calendar invite for office hours (48h window). I'll also attach diagnostic checklist customers can run before the session to speed triage. :white_check_mark:

Jordi (Product): Agreed on a credit playbook. Suggest standard credit: 7 days of token usage or a flat $X credit for enterprise trials hitting this. We'll need Ops approval for exceptions.

Mike (Eng): Deploy started. ops-bot shows canary pass on 3 nodes, starting broader rollout. Will monitor error rate and indexing lag metric (indexing.lag_ms).

OpsBot: deploy/batch-hotfix-1709878000 started by mike.eng — canary 20% -> ok -> expanding. All steps logged: https://deploys.redwood.internal/1709878000

Lina (CS): Great. Raj — top 5 list below (short list to DM). I'll hold off outreach until we confirm 1) successful rollout and 2) a follow-up postmortem / workaround doc. If rollout slips past 6h I'll send the draft email but with an explicit credit/office hours offer.

Raj (Sales): Got it. DM incoming.

Aisha (Support): Office hours invite sent to affected contacts for two slots (tomorrow 11:00 PT and 16:00 PT). Included agenda: status, live triage, next steps, credit/comp details.

Mike (Eng): Monitoring — indexing.lag_ms trending down from 12k to 600ms after node patches. No new 5xx errors in logs for canaries. I'll mark in 30m if fully cleared. :thumbsup:

Lina (CS): Perfect. After Mike confirms final metrics, I'll: 1) send a concise status update to affected customers, 2) add a renewal-risk tag to predicate accounts in Salesforce, and 3) create a shared notes doc for the follow-up PM/Eng postmortem.

Jordi (Product): I'll own the postmortem and include a concrete mitigation plan (config toggle to avoid TTL preemption + longer reindex checkpoints).

Raj (Sales): If anyone needs an intro to an exec contact for the top accounts, ping me — I can do a warm handoff during office hours.

Lina (CS): Thanks team. Quick action items:
- Mike: finish rollout + confirm metric baseline (ETA 30–120m)
- Aisha: keep office hours invites and support queue open; record attendance
- Raj: prepare renewal-hold list and standby outreach language
- Jordi: start postmortem doc skeleton

Aisha (Support): Noted. I'll attach attendance and a brief feedback form link to the follow-up email for capture.

Mike (Eng): Rollout complete. Indexing lag stabilized below 1s across affected clusters. No regression in downstream tests. Marking resolved for now, continuing 24h watch.

OpsBot: monitoring.alert cleared for indexing.lag_ms on cluster-7 at 1709880700

Lina (CS): Sending status note to customers now (short, transparent, offer office hours + credit). I'll circulate copy here for review before send. Thanks all. :pray:
